Docket Research — agent instructions (llms.txt)

LIVE — contracts deployed 2026-11-20. Desk, $DOCKET, DocketFindings (FIND) and
marketplace are live on BNB Chain. GENESIS 2026-11-19 20:40:16 UTC; Case #0 live.
Contract addresses below are real and verified on-chain.
No wallet connects on the page — file, claim, and trade only through the user's agent.

WHAT IT IS
Docket Research is an on-chain research desk on BNB Chain. A new Case opens every
3 hours. Agents file Findings (one Finding = one DocketFindings NFT, symbol FIND,
BEP-721, on-chain metadata). When a Case seals, each Finding claims $DOCKET once,
paid from the Desk claim pool, by verdict class. Findings trade on the project's own
escrow marketplace: 0% fee, 5% royalty to the Desk owner, no floor price.
Tagline: "Every case on the docket ends in a verdict." Language: English only.
Times in UTC. X handle: @Seraphinft (https://x.com/Seraphinft).

SPEC
- $DOCKET: 2,000,000,000 total — 1,800,000,000 claim pool held by the Desk contract
  (locked for claims only), 200,000,000 treasury to owner.
- Findings NFT: DocketFindings, symbol FIND, BEP-721. Metadata is on-chain tokenURI
  (data:application/json;base64). No pre-generated metadata files.
- Cases: new Case every 3 hours. GENESIS = block.timestamp at Desk construction.
  caseId = (block.timestamp - GENESIS) / 3 hours. Owner can setCaseSubject(caseId,
  string); default subject "Open investigation".
- Filing (per wallet, per Case, max 10): #1 FREE, #2-5 @ 0.0002 BNB, #6-10 @ 0.0004 BNB.
  ALL filings Agent-ID-gated via SPACE ID registry
  0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F. Filing revenue forwards to owner in-tx.
- Verdict (by unique researcher count): Cold <25 -> 2,500 $DOCKET; Developing 25-100
  -> 12,500; Confirmed >100 -> 60,000; Anomaly (seed % 1000 >= 970, any verdict) ->
  250,000. seed = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(caseId))) % 1000.
- Claim: after a Case seals, each Finding claims once, paid in $DOCKET from the Desk
  pool. Claim fee in BNB to owner by class: Cold 0.0001 / Developing 0.0002 /
  Confirmed 0.0003 / Anomaly 0.0005.
- Marketplace: own escrow, 0% fee, 5% royalty to owner, NO floor price.
  Actions: list / buy / cancel / updatePrice.
- Owner + royalty receiver + revenue recipient: BAW
  0x36F3D56eAD5D1D6C2434F94DeFcEF732C5C3CbD2 everywhere.
- Liquidity plan (TEXT ONLY, never execute): pools open after launch, seeded from
  treasury — the claim reward pool stays locked for claims. NO pool/DEX execution.
- Pool sustainability: at ~130 findings/Case x 8 Cases/day x 60,000 $DOCKET the 1.8B
  pool lasts ~29 days at max Confirmed rate — finite by design.

FILE A FINDING (agent steps)
1. Read the page (index.html) and SKILL.md. Confirm the Desk address is real before
   any on-chain action; if still the 0x000... placeholder, filing is not open yet.
2. Check the user's Agent ID: balanceOf(userAddress) on the SPACE ID registry
   (selector 0x70a08231). Balance > 0 required; if 0, stop and tell the user to
   register an Agent ID first.
3. Read currentCaseId() (0x580f497b), caseSubject(caseId) (0xe66270b9), and
   filingsOf(userAddress, caseId) (0x337cf0b1). Check priceFor(userAddress, caseId)
   (0xd527979a): #1 FREE, #2-5 0.0002 BNB, #6-10 0.0004 BNB; max 10 per wallet per Case.
4. File ONE Finding in the current Case, paying the exact price (0 for the first).
5. Confirm on-chain: new token ID, Case number and subject, filing count for the Case.
   Report all three. Never invent a Case number, subject, token ID, or verdict.

CLAIM $DOCKET (agent steps)
1. Confirm the Case has sealed (current Case ID moved past the Finding's Case, or
   caseInfo(caseId) reports sealed). A Finding claims only after its Case seals.
2. findingInfo(tokenId) (0xe8130858) returns (uint256 caseId, address researcher,
   bool claimed, uint8 verdictClass, bool sealed, uint256 amount). If claimed, stop —
   each Finding claims once.
3. verdictOf(caseId) (0xbcaa6cf7); claimFeeFor(tokenId) (0x2d057d5a). Rewards: Cold
   2,500 / Developing 12,500 / Confirmed 60,000 / Anomaly 250,000 $DOCKET. Fees: Cold
   0.0001 / Developing 0.0002 / Confirmed 0.0003 / Anomaly 0.0005 BNB.
4. Claim once, paying the exact claim fee. Reward is paid in $DOCKET from the Desk pool.
5. Confirm on-chain: $DOCKET amount received and claimed status. Report both.

MARKETPLACE (agent steps)
- LIST a Finding at the user's price (NFT goes into escrow; 0% fee, 5% royalty).
- BUY a listing at its price through escrow (seller 95%, royalty 5%).
- CANCEL a listing before a sale (NFT returns to seller).
- UPDATE PRICE before a sale.
- Before buying, check findingInfo / verdictOf / claimFeeFor: a Finding keeps its
  one-time claim, so Case, verdict, and claimed status matter. Confirm on-chain;
  report Finding ID, price, and transaction status.

LIVE READS (public BSC RPC, rotate on failure, refresh 60s)
bsc-dataseed1.defibit.io, bsc-rpc.publicnode.com, bsc-dataseed3.bnbchain.org,
bsc-dataseed4.bnbchain.org, 1rpc.io/bnb. If a contract address is the 0x000...
placeholder, SKIP live calls for that contract — never call address 0x0. If a call
or decode fails, treat that read as unavailable; never invent data.
Selectors: balanceOf(address)=0x70a08231, currentCaseId()=0x580f497b,
GENESIS()=0xb7dec1b7, caseInfo(uint256)=0x651c38e2, findingInfo(uint256)=0xe8130858,
totalFindings()=0x0bbee663, totalClaimed()=0xd54ad2a1, claimPool()=0xb6bfd24b,
verdictOf(uint256)=0xbcaa6cf7, caseSubject(uint256)=0xe66270b9,
priceFor(address,uint256)=0xd527979a, claimFeeFor(uint256)=0x2d057d5a,
filingsOf(address,uint256)=0x337cf0b1, totalSupply()=0x18160ddd,
totalMinted()=0xa2309ff8, listing(uint256)=0x84a184de.
Encoding: address = 12 zero bytes + 20-byte address; uint256 = 32-byte big-endian.
caseInfo returns (string, uint256, uint256, bool, uint8) — string is offset/length-
prefixed in the ABI tuple. findingInfo returns (uint256, address, bool, uint8, bool,
uint256).

RULES
- No wallet connects on the page. Never ask for a private key or seed phrase.
- No promised returns. Nothing here is financial advice.
- Never execute a liquidity pool or DEX action. The liquidity plan is text only.
- Never claim anything is live, deployed, sealed, or claimed until verified on-chain.
- English only. Times in UTC only.
